summary: Phase 8 — Fonnte WhatsApp integration + Admin utilities + CMS expansion. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (test_phase8.py). Frontend: title 'Ciltarasa - Premium Frozen Food' correct; OnboardingModal demo hints (081912853950, 'Mode Demo', 123456) successfully removed and replaced with neutral 'Cek WhatsApp kamu untuk lihat kode OTP'; Hero 'Cara Pesan' section renders with 3 default steps from store-config (🛒 Pilih Produk / 📝 Isi Data Pesanan / 🎉 Pesanan Dikirim); Seller sidebar shows all 3 new tabs (WhatsApp Fonnte, Cara Pesan Steps, Reset Pelanggan); Fonnte config page fully functional with token input, seller_notify_phone (6285249682337), wa_notif_enabled toggle, and 'Kirim Test' button. Schema v2.3.1 active with all new fields. Fonnte device is disconnected (expected) → all WA API calls return status:false → wa_sent=false / _wa_seller_sent=false / _wa_buyer_sent=false. Plumbing verified: endpoints return the right shape; OTP code stored in DB and verified end-to-end.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge still visible in bottom-right corner of preview. Existing CSS selectors (#emergent-badge, a[href*='emergent.sh'], [data-emergent-badge], .emergent-badge) and MutationObserver in index.html do NOT match the current badge implementation — likely because the badge is rendered via shadow DOM or different selectors by emergent-main.js. This is EXPECTED per problem statement (#5: 'preview platform-injected, expected to disappear on production custom domain'). No action required for production deployment.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) If badge removal in preview is desired for QA, inspect the actual badge DOM (it's an iframe or shadow-root injected by https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js) and add matching selector to the index.html nuke() function — but per problem statement this disappears on production custom domain so no fix is strictly needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1299 lines (up from 1121). Past the 700-line threshold for some time. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, orders, products, store_config_cms, admin, fonnte_helpers, purchases, insights, recommendations) before adding more endpoints.
test_create_order_includes_wa_seller_sent_flag has a 'return data["id"]' which triggers PytestReturnNotNoneWarning. Cosmetic; doesn't fail.
Fonnte token is stored in plaintext in store_config collection. For production, consider encrypting at rest or moving to a secrets store. Same applies to bank account numbers.

POST /api/admin/test-wa accepts any 'target' phone — no authentication on admin endpoints. Anyone with access to the public API can trigger Fonnte sends and run reset-customers (only protected by the 'RESET' magic word). HIGH PRIORITY: add seller PIN/JWT check on /api/admin/* endpoints before production launch.
POST /api/admin/reset-customers has no rate limit or audit log. Recommended to log a row in a 'audit' collection capturing who/when/scope.
OTP code currently stored as plaintext in users collection with otp_expires_at. Acceptable for 5-min window but consider hashing if SOC compliance is needed.

build_buyer_status_message references APP_URL env var which is not set (defaults to empty). Buyers will get a malformed tracking link like '_Lacak pesanan: /#/buyer → ...'. Set APP_URL=https://ciltarasa.com in production .env.

WebSocket broadcasts 'data_reset' event after reset-customers but frontend logic to react to this (force buyer logout, refresh order lists) is not verified — recommend force-reload behaviour confirmed on buyer side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verifiable surfaces — Title, OnboardingModal, Hero Cara Pesan, all 3 new seller sidebar tabs and Fonnte config page rendered correctly

test_credentials.buyer_otp_real_mode: Generated 6-digit code in db.users[].otp_code (when fonnte_token set)

seed_data_creation: Phase 8 tests create TEST_OTP_User / TEST_Demo / TEST_VerifyDB / TEST_WA_Buyer / TEST_StatusBuyer / TEST_ResetSubject in users+orders. test_reset_customers_scope_orders wipes all orders (resetting sold_count on products). test_reset_customers_scope_users wipes all users. After test run, backend was restarted to re-seed default 5 orders & products via SCHEMA_VERSION check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schema v2.3.1 active. Phase 8 features all working. Key new endpoints: GET/PUT /api/store-config now includes fonnte_token, seller_notify_phone, wa_notif_enabled, how_to_order_steps; POST /api/admin/test-wa (target, message?); POST /api/admin/reset-customers (confirm='RESET', scope=all|orders|users|both). Order responses now include _wa_seller_sent and _wa_buyer_sent booleans. Fonnte device is disconnected in test env → all real WA sends return ok=false / wa_sent=false; this is EXPECTED. To test OTP verify end-to-end when token is configured, read db.users.find_one({'phone':'62xxx'})['otp_code']. Seller sidebar testids: sidebar-tab-whatsapp, sidebar-tab-how-to-order, sidebar-tab-reset-customers. Fonnte config page: data-testid for token input, phone input, toggle, test-wa button. HIGH PRIORITY security concern: /api/admin/* endpoints lack authentication. Note: backend was restarted to re-seed after destructive reset-customers tests. If you run test_phase8.py again, re-seed will not auto-trigger (schema version unchanged) — sample orders may not be regenerated. Workaround: drop db.orders manually, then bump SCHEMA_VERSION and restart, OR add seed logic to be idempotent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only one design concern: 'Made with Emergent' badge in preview is platform-injected and not matched by current nuke selectors; per problem statement this is expected to disappear in production custom domain deployment.
